title: Sarafa Bazaar Night Food Market, Indore - The Ultimate Midnight Street Food Paradise
content:
Sarafa Bazaar Night Food Market, Indore

Sarafa Bazaar Night Food Market is the heart and soul of Indore’s legendary food culture. A bustling jewelry market by day, it magically transforms into India’s most vibrant night food street after 8 PM. Known for its endless variety of delicious snacks, lively atmosphere, and authentic Indori flavors, Sarafa Bazaar is a must-visit destination for food lovers from across the country.

Here, food isn’t just eaten-it’s celebrated. With sizzling stalls, aromatic spices, glowing lights, and energetic vendors, Sarafa offers a food experience unlike anything else in India. From iconic dishes like Bhutte Ka Kees, Sabudana Khichdi, and Garadu to adventurous delights like Joshi Ji’s Flying Dahi Vada, every corner serves something unforgettable.

What Makes Sarafa Bazaar Special?

1. A Night-Only Food Heaven

The market opens exclusively at night, usually from 8 PM till 2 AM, making it perfect for late-night food lovers.

2. Authentic Indori Delicacies

Sarafa is home to the most famous dishes of Indore-crispy, sweet, spicy, tangy, and refreshing!

3. Lively & Safe Atmosphere

Families, students, tourists, and locals all gather here, enjoying food in a safe, friendly environment.

4. A Blend of Culture & Taste

You will see both traditional jewelry shops and modern food stalls-giving Sarafa a unique cultural flavor.

Must-Try Foods at Sarafa Bazaar

  •  Bhutte Ka Kees: A creamy, spicy corn dish-Indore’s top favorite street snack.
  • Sabudana Khichdi: Soft, flavorful, and perfectly cooked-served with a twist of Indori spices.
  • Garadu Chaat: Fried yam tossed with lemon and masala; crispy and spicy.
  • Dahi Bada (Flying Dahi Vada): A fun performance dish-soft vadas topped with curd, masalas, and sweet chutney.
  • Jalebi & Rabdi: Hot jalebis served with thick, creamy rabdi.
  • Shikanji (Indori Style): A milk-based drink with dry fruits-sweet, refreshing, and rich.

Visiting Information

  • Timings: 8 PM - 2 AM
  • Entry Fee: Free (Pay only for food)
  • Location: Near Rajwada, Indore
  • Best Time to Visit: Weekends & winter evenings
